title: Fluvv Domain
description: A business domain: its owning team and experts. One file per domain under governance/domains/. Contracts reference it by their ODCS `domain`. See docs/fluvv/SPEC.md Section 5.

name.description: Domain name, matching the ODCS `domain` of its contracts (e.g. sales).

owner.description: The owning team. A domain has exactly one.
